A complete silver Roman finger-ring. This artefact is a Henig's (1974) Type VIII, a 3rd century AD type. The ring weighs 4.26g. The hoop has an external height of 20.8mm and width of 21.8mm. The band has a sub-circular cross-section with slightly flattened facetted sides. At the base of the loop the band has a width of 2.6mm and thickness of 2.5mm. The band increases in size towards the shoulders…
